Or maybe this is a "drag" game where MOUSE clicks set the start point, and a second MOUSE click sets the end point (drag simulation). For example, click the item, then click the container → the item moves there. My two clicks were both on the item, so nothing happened.
Let me test: click the center of the green container (21, 42). If the green item moves into the container, then the model is "click source, then click destination."
No wait — the first click at (10,30) was on the green item, and the second click at (10,31) was also on the green item. If the model is "click source, then click destination," then the second click on the source does nothing. So next, let me click the green container.
Alternatively, the red plus might be a "delete/hazard" marker. Let me try the container first.
